# HLS.js (manual vendor dependency)

Place the HLS.js browser build in this directory with the exact filename:

`hls.min.js`

Expected path in the repository:

`static/vendor/hls.min.js`

CamWall loads it locally from `/static/vendor/hls.min.js`; no CDN or runtime internet access is required.

The file is not committed here. Download the browser build manually from the official HLS.js release/package and upload it to this directory. Keep the corresponding upstream license with your distribution.
